label: せっけんでてをあらう
reading: せっけんでてをあらう

meanings.en: I wash my hands with soap.
meanings.de: Ich wasche mir die Hände mit Seife.

textReview: English soap and toothpaste are used as mass nouns, towels is plural, and a toothbrush has a singular article. Japanese で marks means with soap and location with supermarket; に marks the location of an object with ある. Omitted Japanese subjects are interpreted as first person. No existing sentence was altered.
